messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@spectra-retail.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — token ramp lattice & early-burn protections

Hi Elena,

Great to meet yesterday — thanks for the candid session. Per our conversation, I pulled together a proposal for the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an initial token ramp so you can validate acceptance gates against your traffic projections. See attached: MAP_Spectra_v3.xlsx and a short term sheet (redwood-pricing-term-sheet.pdf).

High-level MAP milestones we propose:
- Week 0-2: Technical onboarding + canary (capacity reservation for burst testing)
- Month 1: Pilot (soft traffic) — target 150k TPM
- Month 2-3: Ramp — 300k TPM (M2), 550k TPM (M3)
- Month 4-6: Scale — 800k TPM (M4), 1.1M TPM (M5), 1.4M TPM (M6)

Commercial asks tied to milestones:
- Pricing bands by rolling monthly TPM (attached sheet)
- 90-day evaluation period with an early-burn protection cap (we cap charges beyond 120% of M1 expectation for the first 60 days)
- If Spectra hits 1.0M TPM sustained for two months, we move to an expanded discount tier + higher committed SLA.

Can you confirm: 1) the TPM shape above is tractable for your traffic plan, and 2) procurement timeline (legal/PO/DocuSign) — what's your target close window? We are prepared to offer a modest launch credit for a Q4 sign (details in the term sheet) if we can land a firm mutual plan by Aug 26.

Next step: if the ramp looks sensible, I'll draft a one-page MAP with explicit acceptance gates and dates and route it for signature.

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-08-12T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — token ramp lattice & early-burn protections

Thanks Michael — this is a helpful start. A few clarifying points from my side after reviewing the attached MAP:

1) TPM shape: our Q4 promotions compress demand early. We are wary of the steep jump to 300k then 550k in M2-M3. Can we smooth the curve to avoid a big spike in month 2?

2) Early-burn cap: procurement wants a firm cap on initial spend exposure — proposal: cap billable tokens at 110% of agreed M1 for first 30 days and 125% for days 31-60. Anything above should be flagged and require approval.

3) Pricing bands / discounts: can you confirm the exact discount at 1.0M TPM sustained? The term sheet lists a range; procurement needs a single committed band for contract language.

4) Timeline: legal is targeting signature by Sep 9 if we land commercial terms this week and we push DocuSign next week.

Proposed alternative ramp (we think fits our product calendar):
- Month 1: 160k TPM
- Month 2: 260k TPM
- Month 3: 420k TPM
- Month 4: 680k TPM
- Month 5: 960k TPM
- Month 6: 1.25M TPM

If you can accept the smoothing and the tighter early-burn cap, procurement can push the legal timeline up to meet your Aug 26 target for an in-principle MAP.

Best,

Elena Rossi
Head of Product Ops | Spectra Retail
elena@spectra-retail.com

Elena — really appreciate the specificity. We can meet you halfway on smoothing and tighten the early-burn protections. Updated proposal below, and I’ve also noted the single committed discount band you requested.

Revised monthly TPM (concession):
- Month 1: 160k TPM
- Month 2: 260k TPM
- Month 3: 420k TPM
- Month 4: 700k TPM
- Month 5: 960k TPM
- Month 6: 1.25M TPM

Early-burn protections (agreed):
- Days 0-30: chargeable tokens capped at 110% of M1 projection
- Days 31-60: capped at 125% of M1 projection; overages require written approval from Spectra product ops

Discount band (committed):
- Sustained >= 1.0M TPM for two consecutive months -> 12% unit discount off list price (applies to subsequent billing cycle)

Additional commercial concessions we can offer if we sign by Aug 26: a one-time 15% launch credit applied to the first full billing month + a 6-week technical SLA exception that lets us run a more aggressive canary at no penalty.

I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet and send a one-page summary + DocuSign link for signatures; procurement details look compatible with a Sep 9 legal close if we hit the in-principle agreement this week.

DocuSign preview (internal link): https://www.docusign.com/en/spectra/spec-deal-2026
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

If this works, I’ll route the one-pager and redline the term sheet to freeze the discount band.

Thanks — Michael

Subject: Internal: Spectra proposal acceptability & approval for 15% launch credit

Folks — quick internal note following the Spectra thread. Elena/Procurement accepted the smoothed TPM curve and tightened early-burn caps. I offered the following commercial concessions to secure an in-principle MAP by Aug 26: 

1) One-time 15% launch credit applied to the first full billing month (to offset promotional Q4 consumption risk)
2) 12% committed discount band once Spectra sustains >=1.0M TPM for two consecutive months
3) 6-week technical SLA exception to enable canary burst testing during onboarding (no overage penalties during the exception window subject to the early-burn caps)

Asks: 
- Lauren: can you greenlight the 15% launch credit (finance-approved cap is 20% for strategic launches) and confirm any revenue recognition notes we should surface?
- Priyom: please update the MAP_Spectra_v3.xlsx with the revised TPM curve and add the exact acceptance-gate dates so legal has a one-pager to attach to the contract.
- Ben: can you coordinate with Solutions on the canary capacity reservation and confirm GPU pool availability for an aggressive 6-week test starting Sep 1?

I’m aiming to have the DocuSign out to Spectra by EOD Aug 14 if we have internal ok. If there are material objections to the credit or the SLA exception, flag them now — the procurement team is pushing for the Aug 26 in-principle MAP.

Thanks,
Michael
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
